items.title_kr: Macy's와 Disney가 Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년 기념 Holiday Collection을 공개했습니다.
items.title_en: Disney and Macy's debut Thanksgiving parade collection
items.body_kr: Thanksgiving Day Parade의 100주년 역사를 담은 exclusive Disney Capsule Collection과 Holiday merchandise가 retail channel을 통해 출시되었습니다. IP 기반의 시즌 merchandise sourcing 및 holiday promotion 기획 시 참고할 만한 트렌드입니다.
items.body_en: Macy's and Disney launched an exclusive holiday collection celebrating a century of parade history. This serves as a strong reference for IP-driven seasonal merchandise sourcing and holiday promotions.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 키즈 스케이팅웨어 접근성 강화를 위한 signature collection 런칭
items.title_en: Greg Lutzka Launches Signature Collection at Kohl’s to Make Skating More Affordable for Kids
items.body_kr: Kohl's launched an affordable activewear signature collection for kids in partnership with pro skater Greg Lutzka. It offers valuable insights for budget-friendly kids' activewear category expansions.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 고객 수요 둔화에 대응하여 key item 중심 가격 인하 단행
items.title_en: Kohl’s drops prices on key items as customer interest fades
items.body_kr: Kohl's is dropping prices on key merchandise and tightening promotions to counter fading consumer demand. It highlights current pricing pressures and inventory sell-through strategies across retail.

items.title_kr: Levi's, tariff refunds와 wholesale 채널 성과에 힘입어 실적 방어
items.title_en: Wholesale, tariff refunds deliver for Levi’s in rough Q3
items.body_kr: Levi's successfully navigated a rough Q3 leveraging tariff refunds and strong wholesale channel performance, lifting its full-year guidance. This underscores the critical role of margin recovery and wholesale partnerships.
